'''Phis Benlip''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Following Riboga's return to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], he sent Benlip and a group of thugs to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]], to extort money from businesses on the world. Benlip worked his way through various resorts on the world and eventually came to [[Greentree Pointe]], where he extorted money from hotels and other tourist facilities. However, while Benlip and his men were attempting extract money from an amusement park owner, they were confronted by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the Cularin system. Benlip and his thugs fled the scene by jumping into cars on the ''[[Meteor Strike!!]]'' rollercoaster ride, and heroes pursued them.
